safeguards.text: Limit access to named roles and review permissions regularly.
Collect and share only the fields required for the approved purpose.
Set retention, deletion, and incident-response responsibilities before launch.
Record the approved purpose, data owner, and control evidence in the governance register.
Use protected matching instead of transferring raw identifiers.
Measure and remediate re-identification risk before combining datasets.
De-identify sensitive records before they leave the originating system.
Create a separate approval gate for any secondary use.

karlsgate.label: Protected matching
karlsgate.text: Identify records shared across parties without transferring raw identifiers to the other party.

karlsgate.label: Re-identification risk remediation
karlsgate.text: Measure how dataset combination could reveal a person or sensitive attribute, then reduce that risk before release.

karlsgate.label: De-identification
karlsgate.text: Transform sensitive records so directly identifying values are not exposed during the approved workflow.

karlsgate.label: Data minimization
karlsgate.text: Limit collection, processing, and disclosure to fields required for the documented purpose.

karlsgate.label: Governance policy execution
karlsgate.text: Turn approved purpose, access, retention, and deletion rules into enforceable workflow controls and evidence.
